meta.name: HTTPS Proxy
meta.shortDescription: HTTPS reverse proxy for other pups (TLS self-signed by default + web admin)
meta.longDescription: **TLS is on by default** (self-signed cert, SAN **dogebox**). Open **`https://dogebox:<PUBLIC_PORT>/__proxy/`** and accept the browser warning (or trust `cert.pem`). Default admin token is **`DOGECOIN`** (override with **`HTTPS_PROXY_ADMIN_TOKEN`**). Turn off **Enable HTTPS** in the UI only if you need plain **HTTP**. If Firefox shows **SSL_ERROR_RX_RECORD_TOO_LONG**, you opened **https://** while the proxy was in HTTP-only mode — use **http://** for that mode, or re-enable HTTPS. **Port** in the URL must match **`PUBLIC_PORT`**. Use **port listeners** to map each listen port to an upstream pup. This is **not** Let’s Encrypt.

sections.name: HTTP/TLS
sections.description: Listen port on 0.0.0.0 (HTTPS/TLS by default). With no port listeners in the UI, this single port is used. If you add port listeners, each row has its own port (PUBLIC_PORT is ignored).

sections.name: Storage & admin
sections.description: Config and TLS material persist under HTTPS_PROXY_STORAGE. Set a fixed admin token to skip the generated admin.token file.
